spans.s: शैव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to Śiva.
शैव (II) m. A member of the Śaiva sect.
शैव (III) n. Name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
शैव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to Śiva.
शैवल (I) m. A kind of aquatic plant, moss.
शैवल (II) n. A kind of fragrant wood.
शैवाल m. The same as शेवल q.v.
सैवाल n. Name of an aquatic plant, (the same as शैवाल q.v.).
शैव्य m. 1. Name of one of the four horses of Kṛṣṇa; 2. name of a king; 3. a horse in general.
